settings.heading: A lift for your garage, at the price a shop pays.

settings.text: Eight AMGO lifts — five two-post, three four-post — bought through the same distributor the big shops use, sold at a cash price with the freight spelled out. We run one in our own bay in Sussex.

settings.title: Cars & crossovers
settings.vehicles: Model Y, Camry, Wrangler — under 6,000 lb

settings.title: 3/4- and one-ton
settings.ceiling: needs 12′ ceiling — sets up at 143″, 155″ or 167″

settings.title: Storage, not service
settings.vehicles: Park one car over another; 7–9K four-post
settings.ceiling: 83″ columns (407-P, 408-P), 97″ on the 409-HP; ceiling needed = the car on top plus the runway — ask us

settings.eyebrow: Start here — what are you lifting?

settings.title: The eight we keep in front
settings.description: Five two-post, three four-post. Forward, Rotary, Atlas, Coats and the rest of the AMGO line are in the full catalog.

settings.title: Before it ships, we check your numbers.
settings.text: Ceiling height, concrete, and power against the spec sheet. If it won't fit, you hear it from us before the crate exists, not from the installer after.

settings.title: You pick how it arrives.
settings.text: Business with a forklift: flat zone rate on AMGO (freight is included on Forward). Home driveway: liftgate truck, +$225 — the driver sets it on the ground, it doesn't go inside. Sussex pickup: free, bring a trailer.

settings.title: The carrier calls you for a window.
settings.text: Usually a four-hour block on a weekday. Somebody has to be there. Tracking hits your email the day it leaves.

settings.title: Look before you sign.
settings.text: Count pieces, photograph anything bent, write it on the receipt. Do that and a damage claim is our problem to chase, not yours.

settings.heading: It's a 12-foot, 1,600-lb crate on a freight truck. Here's how that goes.
settings.text: Most sites tell you this after you've paid. Freight is the part people get surprised by, so it's on the front page.

settings.heading: Tire changers & balancers
settings.text: Coats, made in Tennessee, and AMGO. Coats is quote-only; we turn quotes around the same day.

settings.heading: Rotary, Atlas, BendPak, Challenger
settings.text: We sell them; we just don't print a price, because theirs moves. Send the model number and a ZIP and you'll have a landed price today.

settings.heading: Who you're buying from
settings.text: I'm Dave Lucas. I own Big Wave Auto, an independent dealership in Sussex, and we recondition our own inventory on a lift in our bay. BW Lift & Tool is me selling the equipment I'd buy again, through a distributor I've dealt with for years, at a price that's on the page. Come see one run before you buy — by appointment, Mon–Sat 9–6.
